name: Marsh Stew
summary: Cook marsh stew at the kitchen fire.
startText: A proper marsh stew is pike, riverleaf and sunroot, cooked on my fire. Pike and sunroot both come from Heronreach. Cook three and bring them to me.
inProgressText: Three marsh stews, cooked at the fire beside me.
completionText: Now that is a stew. Keep two; I only wanted to taste it.
